title: Dimension Tracker
description: Plugin for Minecraft Paper-based servers that colors player names in chat and TAB list based on current dimension
body:
# DimensionTracker

Plugin for Minecraft Paper-based servers that colors player names in chat and TAB list based on current dimension

> **Note:** For Russian speakers there is a full translated description [here](https://github.com/prokdo/DimensionTracker/blob/main/README_RU.md)

## Features

- Chat name colors by dimension
- TAB list name colors by dimension
- Fully configurable colors per dimension and per world (HEX and named colors supported)
- Custom worlds support
- Ability to disable chat or TAB coloring independently
- Built-in AFK detection with configurable timeout and color
- Manual AFK toggle
- No initial configuration required, works out of the box
- Optional [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) integration

## Colors

| Dimension | Color  |
| --------- | ------ |
| Overworld | Green  |
| Nether    | Red    |
| The End   | Purple |
| AFK       | Gray   |

## Have a question?

Full documentation including configuration reference, commands and permissions is available on the [wiki](https://github.com/prokdo/DimensionTracker/wiki)
